prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic photorealistic style, vertical screen, first-person visitor perspective. Inside a dimly lit KTV private room, purple and blue neon laser lights flash in the background. An adult Asian woman sits on a black leather sofa, long black hair draped over her shoulders, wearing a black off-shoulder sequined sweater and a delicate necklace. Initially she looks to the side, then turns toward the camera with a warm smile and says, "Hello, you arrived late." The camera smoothly moves down to show her silver diamond-detailed pointed high heel. She removes it naturally and lazily while one foot is already barefoot on the reflective floor. Keep realistic light-and-shadow texture and high-definition image quality.
